snippet.title: Dead Party | 4 Players, Endless Zombie Fun
snippet.description:
Zombies, UFOs, and a lot of rock music. Four heroes are on a mission to keep Shady Hill from completely falling into chaos.

Dead Party is a 4-player co-op party action game. Team up, fight the undead, and see how far you get.

Find out more on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1270660/Dead_Party/

#PartyGame #CoOpGaming #Zombies
